verses.en: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ru-hamah.
verses.pt: Dizei a vossos irmãos: Ami; e a vossas irmãs: Ruama.
verses.en_web: “Say to your brothers, ‘My people!’ and to your sisters, ‘My loved one!’
verses.en_bbe: Say to your brothers, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah.

verses.en: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
verses.pt: Contendei com vossa mãe, contendei; porque ela não é minha mulher, e eu não sou seu marido; para que ela afaste as suas prostituições da sua face e os seus adultérios de entre os seus seios;
verses.en_web: Contend with your mother! Contend, for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband; and let her put away her prostitution from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
verses.en_bbe: Take up the cause against your mother, take it up, for she is not my wife, and I am not her husband; let her put away her loose ways from her face, and her false ways from between her breasts;

verses.en: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
verses.pt: para que eu não a deixe despida, e a ponha como no dia em que nasceu, e a faça como um deserto, e a torne como uma terra seca, e a mate à sede.
verses.en_web: Lest I strip her naked, and make her bare as in the day that she was born, and make her like a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and kill her with thirst.
verses.en_bbe: For fear that I may take away her robe from her, making her uncovered as in the day of her birth; making her like a waste place and a dry land, causing her death through need of water.

verses.en: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.
verses.pt: Até de seus filhos não me compadecerei; porquanto são filhos de prostituições.
verses.en_web: Indeed, on her children I will have no mercy; for they are children of unfaithfulness;
verses.en_bbe: And I will have no mercy on her children, for they are the children of her loose ways.

verses.en: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.
verses.pt: porque sua mãe se prostituiu; aquela que os concebeu houve- se torpemente; porque diz: Irei após os meus amantes, que me dão o meu pão e a minha água, a minha lã e o meu linho, o meu óleo e as minhas bebidas.
verses.en_web: For their mother has played the prostitute. She who conceived them has done shamefully; for she said, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.’
verses.en_bbe: For their mother has been untrue; she who gave them birth has done things of shame, for she said, I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my linen, my oil and my wine.

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
verses.pt: Portanto, eis que lhe cercarei o caminho com espinhos, e contra ela levantarei uma sebe, para que ela não ache as suas veredas.
verses.en_web: Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can’t find her way.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause I will put thorns in her road, building up a wall round her so that she may not go on her way.

verses.en: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.
verses.pt: Ela irá em seguimento de seus amantes, mas não os alcançará; buscá-los-á, mas não os achará; então dirá: Irei, e voltarei a meu primeiro marido, porque melhor me ia então do que agora.
verses.en_web: She will follow after her lovers, but she won’t overtake them; and she will seek them, but won’t find them. Then she will say, ‘I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.’
verses.en_bbe: And if she goes after her lovers she will not overtake them; if she makes search for them she will not see them; then will she say, I will go back to my first husband, for then it was better for me than now.

verses.en: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.
verses.pt: Ora, ela não reconhece que fui eu o que lhe dei o grão, e o vinho, e o azeite, e que lhe multipliquei a prata e o ouro, que eles usaram para Baal.
verses.en_web: For she did not know that I gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and multiplied to her silver and gold, which they used for Baal.
verses.en_bbe: For she had no knowledge that it was I who gave her the grain and the wine and the oil, increasing her silver and gold which they gave to the Baal.

verses.en: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.
verses.pt: Portanto, tornarei a tirar o meu grão a seu tempo e o meu vinho no seu tempo determinado; e arrebatarei a minha lã e o meu linho, com que cobriam a sua nudez.
verses.en_web: Therefore I will take back my grain in its time, and my new wine in its season, and will pluck away my wool and my flax which should have covered her nakedness.
verses.en_bbe: So I will take away again my grain in its time and my wine, and I will take away my wool and my linen with which her body might have been covered.

verses.en: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.
verses.pt: E agora descobrirei a sua vileza diante dos olhos dos seus amantes, e ninguém a livrará da minha mão.
verses.en_web: Now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of my hand.
verses.en_bbe: And now I will make her shame clear before the eyes of her lovers, and no one will take her out of my hand.

verses.en: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
verses.pt: Também farei cessar todo o seu gozo, as suas festas, as suas luas novas, e os seus sábados, e todas as suas assembléias solenes.
verses.en_web: I will also cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies.
verses.en_bbe: And I will put an end to all her joy, her feasts, her new moons, and her Sabbaths, and all her regular meetings.

verses.en: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
verses.pt: E devastarei a sua vide e a sua figueira, de que ela diz: É esta a paga que me deram os meus amantes; eu, pois, farei delas um bosque, e as feras do campo as devorarão.
verses.en_web: I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees, about which she has said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers have given me; and I will make them a forest,’ and the animals of the field shall eat them.
verses.en_bbe: And I will make waste her vines and her fig-trees, of which she has said, These are the payments which my lovers have made to me; and I will make them a waste of trees, and the beasts of the field will take them for food.

verses.en: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Castigá-la-ei pelos dias dos baalins, nos quais elas lhes queimava incenso, e se adornava com as suas arrecadas e as suas jóias, e, indo atrás dos seus amantes, se esquecia de mim, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: I will visit on her the days of the Baals, to which she burned incense, when she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and went after her lovers, and forgot me,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And I will give her punishment for the days of the Baals, to whom she has been burning perfumes, when she made herself fair with her nose-rings and her jewels, and went after her lovers, giving no thought to me, says the Lord.

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.
verses.pt: Portanto, eis que eu a atrairei, e a levarei para o deserto, e lhe falarei ao coração.
verses.en_web: “Therefore behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause I will make her come into the waste land and will say words of comfort to her.

verses.en: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: E lhe darei as suas vinhas dali, e o vale de Acor por porta de esperança; e ali responderá, como nos dias da sua mocidade, e como no dia em que subiu da terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: And I will give her vine-gardens from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will give her answer there as in the days when she was young, and as in the time when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.en: And it shall be at that day, saith the LORD, that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.
verses.pt: E naquele dia, diz o Senhor, ela me chamará meu marido; e não me chamará mais meu Baal.
verses.en_web: It will be in that day,” says Yahweh, “that you will call me ‘my husband,’ and no longer call me ‘my master.’
verses.en_bbe: And in that day, says the Lord, you will say to me, Ishi; and you will never again give me the name of Baali;

verses.en: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
verses.pt: Pois da sua boca tirarei os nomes dos baalins, e não mais se fará menção desses nomes.
verses.en_web: For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they will no longer be mentioned by name.
verses.en_bbe: For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and never again will she say their names.

verses.en: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.
verses.pt: Naquele dia farei por eles aliança com as feras do campo, e com as aves do céu, e com os répteis da terra; e da terra tirarei o arco, e a espada, e a guerra, e os farei deitar em segurança.
verses.en_web: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the creeping things of the ground. I will break the bow, the sword, and the battle out of the land, and will make them lie down safely.
verses.en_bbe: And in that day I will make an agreement for them with the beasts of the field and the birds of heaven and the things which go low on the earth; I will put an end to the bow and the sword and war in all the land, and will make them take their rest in peace.

verses.en: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.
verses.pt: E desposar-te-ei comigo para sempre; sim, desposar-te-ei comigo em justiça, e em juízo, e em amorável benignidade, e em misericórdias;
verses.en_web: I will betroth you to me forever. Yes, I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, and in compassion.
verses.en_bbe: And I will take you as my bride for ever; truly, I will take you as my bride in righteousness and in right judging, in love and in mercies.

verses.en: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the LORD.
verses.pt: e desposar-te-ei comigo em fidelidade, e conhecerás ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness; and you shall know Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: I will take you as my bride in good faith, and you will have knowledge of the Lord.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
verses.pt: Naquele dia responderei, diz o Senhor; responderei aos céus, e estes responderão a terra;
verses.en_web: It will happen in that day, I will respond,” says Yahweh, “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth;
verses.en_bbe: And it will be, in that day, says the Lord, that I will give an answer to the heavens, and the heavens to the earth;

verses.en: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
verses.pt: a terra responderá ao trigo, e ao vinho, e ao azeite, e estes responderão a Jizreel.
verses.en_web: and the earth will respond to the grain, and the new wine, and the oil; and they will respond to Jezreel.
verses.en_bbe: And the earth will give its answer to the grain and the wine and the oil, and they will give an answer to Jezreel;

verses.en: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.
verses.pt: E semeá-lo-ei para mim na terra, e compadecer-me-ei de Lo-Ruama; e a e Lo-Ami direi: Tu és meu povo; e ele dirá: Tu és o meu Deus.
verses.en_web: I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy; and I will tell those who were not my people, ‘You are my people;’ and they will say, ‘My God!’”
verses.en_bbe: And I will put her as seed in the earth, and I will have mercy on her to whom no mercy was given; and I will say to those who were not my people, You are my people, and they will say, My God.
